## Birch Harbor support invoices: January–March 2025

| Service month | Invoice | Amount | Source |
|---|---|---:|---|
| January 2025 | 25-01 | $100 | [current/jan.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-S/current/jan.txt) |
| February 2025 | 25-02 | $190 | [other/feb.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-S/other/feb.txt) |
| March 2025 | 25-03 | $120 | [current/mar.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-S/current/mar.txt) |

The three listed amounts total **$410**, if each listed invoice is accepted as the applicable invoice for its service month.

The agreement says one invoice is required for each of these months ([current/agreement.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-S/current/agreement.txt)). The February record in `other/` is for February 2025; a separate February 2024 invoice ([other/old-feb.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-S/other/old-feb.txt)) is outside the reporting period and is not included.

**Decision needed:** Should the $190 February 2025 invoice be accepted as the applicable February invoice and included in the report total? The records identify it as February 2025, but provide no payment or approval status. The available records support a $410 invoice total, not confirmation that the invoices were paid.
